title: omicstra: a multi-agent MCP server for cross-modal embedding alignment, fusion, and evidence-based routing in spatial biology
description:
A multi-agent MCP server for cross-modal reasoning in spatial biology. Aligns embeddings from H&E histopathology (Virchow2, 1280d) and spatial transcriptomics (Novae GNN + gpath2vec pathway embeddings) into a shared representation space, then exposes cross-modal retrieval and evaluation through the Model Context Protocol. Given a tissue section with co-registered morphology and expression, the server can: retrieve the transcriptomic niche most similar to a histological region and vice versa; evaluate whether alignment preserves niche-type biology (cluster coherence, linear probe accuracy) better than either modality alone; test whether the shared space encodes interpretable pathway signals - including immune checkpoint, interferon regulation, TGF-beta signaling and ECM remodeling among others - via per-pathway CCA across tissue compartments; and generate rerunnable notebooks with full provenance. Questions are routed from a cohort's own recorded evidence, refusing when that evidence is absent rather than inheriting another cohort's result. The server ships no model - agents are deterministic components orchestrated with LangGraph, and a client supplies the LLM.

v1.3 completes the evaluation chain and the question-to-execution path. v1.0 shipped the read path - inventory, EDA, admissibility gate and routing - over stdio and HTTP. v1.1 added encode, niche join, evaluation stages, six hypothesis guards (Recall@K and MRR for cross-modal retrieval, ARI and linear probe for manifold biology, CCA for pathway generalization), evidence pack construction via omicstra promote, and omicstra run end-to-end. v1.2 made both modality agents reachable with persistent run handles and ran a second cohort through them. v1.3 adds: H2-C biology scoring and H3 pathway CCA ported to callable measures; notebook generation for all 7 analytical units; a pathway_assay bridge node with flag-driven artifact selection; configuration-driven alignment dispatch where classical baselines run the same chain as contrastive; and the question-to-execution path restored. 22 MCP tools, 4 resources, stdio + HTTP transport.

creators.name: Sanati, Nasim

notes: Funded by the ResearchHub Foundation (doi:10.55277/researchhub.6ou1w3h3). Seed cohort: 92 triple-negative breast cancer patients from Wang et al. 2024, Nature Communications 15:10232 - original Spatial Transcriptomics platform, co-registered with H&E whole-slide images. The package ships no cohort data; it is pointed at a cohort directory.
